globalStatistics.title: Your global statistics
globalStatistics.description: Explore your visits and rides with clear reference points, without mixing your private history with community rankings.

loading.title: Building your overview
loading.description: Your private statistics are being prepared.

errors.title: The overview could not load
errors.invalidFilter: This filter is no longer available. Clear it to see your whole passport.
errors.load: Your statistics could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

filters.title: Refine the overview
filters.description: Filters are remembered only for this session.

empty.title: No data for this overview
empty.description: Add a visit to reveal your first statistics.
empty.filtered: No visit matches these filters. Try another park or year.

charts.empty: There is not enough data for this chart yet.

activity.title: Your activity over time
activity.description: Compare recorded visits and rides for each year.
activity.denominator: Each visit belongs to its entered year, even when the date is approximate. Every ride outcome is counted.

parks.title: Your most visited parks
parks.description: Parks are ordered first by visit count, then by ride count.
parks.denominator: Archived visits are excluded. Rides include every outcome recorded in the displayed visits.

items.title: Your most ridden attractions
items.description: See the attractions on which you completed the most rides.
items.denominator: Only rides marked as completed are included in this personal ranking.

outcomes.denominator: Each recorded ride belongs to one outcome category; their sum matches the displayed total.

rating.title: How your ratings evolved
rating.description: Yearly park and ride averages remain separate.
rating.denominator: Each average uses only raw ratings available for that year. Missing ratings remain empty and are never replaced with zero.
rating.empty: At least one visit or ride rating is needed to show this evolution.
